_note: Parameters of an openly documented reference turbine, used only by tests/selftest.py and demo/run_demo.sh. The engine itself has no default turbine; every parameter is a required input.
name: IEA-3.4-130-RWT (IEA Wind TCP Task 37 land-based reference wind turbine)
source: Bortolotti, P. et al. (2019), IEA Wind TCP Task 37: Systems Engineering in Wind Energy - WP2.1 Reference Wind Turbines, NREL/TP-5000-73492, Table 2 p.19, https://www.nrel.gov/docs/fy19osti/73492.pdf
lwa_basis: estimated from rated power via van den Berg et al. 2008 regression L_W = 10.0*log10(P_kW) + 71.0 dB(A) (10-m wind 8 m/s); NOT a published property of this turbine; mild extrapolation above ~3 MW data range
lwa_source: van den Berg, F., Pedersen, E., Bouma, J., Bakker, R. (2008), WINDFARMperception: Visual and acoustic impact of wind turbine farms on residents, Final Report, section 3.2 p.9, https://pure.rug.nl/ws/files/14620621/WFp-final.pdf
blade_chord_basis: maximum blade chord (4.298 m at 25.8 % span) from outer_shape.chord in IEA-3.4-130-RWT.yaml; using the maximum chord gives the largest (conservative) flicker calculation distance
